# FG-DB-0017

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`job-queue-backlog`](../../ops/runbooks/job-queue-backlog.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_deep_or_waiting_queue_is_reported_per_kind` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: バックグラウンドの処理が滞っています。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: Background tasks are backed up. Contact the administrator.
- id: Tugas latar belakang menumpuk. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

forge doctor found the job queue not being worked off. reason=queue_wait: the oldest ready job of a kind waits longer than 10 min — no forge worker runs, or the running build has no handler for the kind, or one long job blocks the worker (one job at a time per worker); queue_depth: more than 1000 ready jobs of one kind — a caller enqueues one job per item (the queue is meant for internal work, never one job per edge device; fleet-wide work is one job that walks its targets); reaper_behind (jobs.expired_leases): a lease expired more than 60 s ago and is still running — no forge worker runs its reaper (it runs every 30 s).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

forge doctor (`jobs.queue_depth`, `jobs.expired_leases`) reports `reason`, `kind`, and for queue_depth / queue_wait `ready` (per kind, capped at 100000+) and `oldest_wait_ms`; for reaper_behind `expired_leases` (capped), `job_id`, `worker_id`, `attempt` and `expired_ms`. Check that a `forge worker` process runs (systemctl status forge-worker) and read its startup line `forge.worker.jobs` (`job_kinds` = registered handlers) and its failures (`task=job_runner` / `task=job_reaper`). Read-only: SELECT kind, count(*), min(run_after) FROM forge.jobs WHERE state = 'queued' AND run_after <= now() GROUP BY kind;

## 対処 (fix)

queue_wait / reaper_behind: start `forge worker` (an approved runbook step) or deploy the build that has the kind's handler; queue_depth: find the caller that enqueues per-item jobs and make it one job that walks its items. Never move rows between states by hand.
